verdict.rationale: TruffleHog is a security scanner, so SBOM generation is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents only secret detection, verification and analysis, with nothing showing SPDX or CycloneDX SBOM output for a project or image. Cosign-signed checksums on TruffleHog's own release artifacts are a different supply-chain feature and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can generate a software bill of materials (SPDX or CycloneDX) for my project or image
